ei.title: 2번: The Unique Patterns of the Human Iris
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: The iris is a muscle found in the eye. It can control the amount of light that enters the eye by opening and closing the pupil. Each of a person's two irises has a pattern of textures which is different from that of the other, as these patterns are not genetic. DNA decides the color and structure of the iris, but the patterns are formed randomly while the baby is still developing in the womb. As the baby opens and closes its eyes, the tissue of the iris moves and folds, creating patterns. Like fingerprints, iris patterns are unique and rarely change over time, so they are now often used for identification.

questions.passage: The iris is a muscle found in the eye. It can (A)[block / control] the amount of light that enters the eye by opening and closing the pupil. Each of a person's two irises has a pattern of textures which is (B)[different / identical] from that of the other, as these patterns are not genetic. DNA decides the color and structure of the iris, but the patterns are formed randomly while the baby is still developing in the womb. As the baby opens and closes its eyes, the tissue of the iris moves and folds, creating patterns. Like fingerprints, iris patterns are (C)[unique / common] and rarely change over time, so they are now often used for identification.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) control=조절하다 / block=막다 (B) different=다른 / identical=동일한 (C) unique=고유한 / common=흔한
det.analysis:
① block—different—common: (A) 홍채는 빛의 양을 '막는' 게 아니라 동공을 여닫아 조절(control)함, (C) 홍채 무늬는 흔한 게 아니라 고유(unique)함
② control—different—unique: 빛의 양을 조절 + 다른 홍채와 다름 + 고유한 무늬 ←정답
③ control—identical—unique: (B) 두 홍채 무늬는 동일한 게 아니라 서로 다름(different)
④ block—identical—common: (A)(B)(C) 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 홍채는 빛의 양을 control(조절), 두 홍채는 서로 different(다름), 무늬는 unique(고유)

questions.passage: The iris is a muscle found in the eye. It can control the amount of light that (A)[leaves / enters] the eye by opening and closing the pupil. Each of a person's two irises has a pattern of textures which is different from that of the other, as these patterns are not genetic. DNA decides the color and structure of the iris, but the patterns are formed (B)[randomly / regularly] while the baby is still developing in the womb. As the baby opens and closes its eyes, the tissue of the iris moves and folds, creating patterns. Like fingerprints, iris patterns are unique and (C)[rarely / frequently] change over time, so they are now often used for identification.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) enters=들어오다 / leaves=떠나다 (B) randomly=무작위로 / regularly=규칙적으로 (C) rarely=드물게 / frequently=자주
det.analysis:
① leaves—randomly—rarely: (A) 빛이 눈에서 '나가는' 게 아니라 눈으로 들어옴(enters)
② enters—regularly—rarely: (B) 무늬는 규칙적으로가 아니라 무작위로(randomly) 형성됨
③ enters—randomly—rarely: 빛이 눈으로 들어옴 + 무작위로 형성 + 드물게 변함 ←정답
④ leaves—regularly—frequently: (A)(B)(C) 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 빛이 눈으로 enters(들어옴), 무늬는 randomly(무작위) 형성, rarely(드물게) 변함

questions.passage: The iris is a muscle found in the eye. It can control the amount of light that enters the eye by opening and closing the pupil. Each of a person's two irises has a pattern of textures which is different from that of the other, as these patterns are not genetic. DNA (A)[hides / decides] the color and structure of the iris, but the patterns are formed randomly while the baby is still (B)[developing / disappearing] in the womb. As the baby opens and closes its eyes, the tissue of the iris moves and folds, creating patterns. Like fingerprints, iris patterns are unique and rarely change over time, so they are now often used for (C)[identification / decoration].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) decides=결정하다 / hides=숨기다 (B) developing=발달하는 / disappearing=사라지는 (C) identification=신원 확인 / decoration=장식
det.analysis:
① decides—developing—identification: DNA가 색·구조를 결정 + 아기가 자궁에서 발달하는 동안 + 신원 확인에 사용 ←정답
② hides—developing—identification: (A) DNA가 색·구조를 '숨기는' 게 아니라 결정(decides)함
③ decides—disappearing—decoration: (B)(C) 아기는 사라지는 게 아니라 발달(developing)하고, 무늬는 장식이 아니라 신원 확인(identification)에 쓰임
④ hides—disappearing—decoration: (A)(B)(C) 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: DNA가 색·구조를 decides(결정), 아기가 developing(발달), 무늬가 identification(신원 확인)에 쓰임

questions.passage: The iris is a ①<u>muscle</u> found in the eye. It can ②<u>control</u> the amount of light that enters the eye by opening and closing the pupil. Each of a person's two irises has a pattern of textures which is ③<u>identical</u> from that of the other, as these patterns are not genetic. DNA decides the color and structure of the iris, but the patterns are formed ④<u>randomly</u> while the baby is still developing in the womb. As the baby opens and closes its eyes, the tissue of the iris moves and folds, creating patterns. Like fingerprints, iris patterns are unique and rarely change over time, so they are now often used for identification.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① muscle=근육 ② control=조절하다 ③ different→identical (부적절) ④ randomly=무작위로
det.analysis:
① muscle: 홍채는 눈 속에 있는 근육이다 — 적절
② control: 홍채가 빛의 양을 조절한다 — 적절
③ identical: 두 홍채의 무늬가 서로 '동일하다'? 각 홍채 무늬는 서로 다르다(different)가 원문 ←정답
④ randomly: 무늬는 무작위로 형성된다 — 적절
det.tip: 각 홍채 무늬는 서로 different(다름). identical(동일한)은 정반대라 부적절

questions.passage: The iris is a muscle found in the eye. It can control the amount of light that ①<u>enters</u> the eye by opening and closing the pupil. Each of a person's two irises has a pattern of textures which is different from that of the other, as these patterns are not genetic. DNA decides the color and ②<u>structure</u> of the iris, but the patterns are formed randomly while the baby is still developing in the womb. As the baby opens and closes its eyes, the ③<u>tissue</u> of the iris moves and folds, creating patterns. Like fingerprints, iris patterns are ④<u>common</u> and rarely change over time, so they are now often used for identification.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① enters=들어오다 ② structure=구조 ③ tissue=조직 ④ unique→common (부적절)
det.analysis:
① enters: 빛이 눈으로 들어온다 — 적절
② structure: DNA가 홍채의 색과 구조를 결정한다 — 적절
③ tissue: 홍채의 조직이 움직이고 접힌다 — 적절
④ common: 홍채 무늬가 '흔하다'? 지문과 신원 확인에 쓰인다는 흐름상 고유(unique)함이 원문 ←정답
det.tip: 홍채 무늬는 지문처럼 unique(고유)해서 신원 확인에 쓰임. common(흔한)은 반대

questions.passage: The iris is a muscle found in the eye. It can control the amount of ①<u>light</u> that enters the eye by opening and closing the pupil. Each of a person's two irises has a pattern of textures which is different from that of the other, as these patterns are not genetic. DNA decides the ②<u>color</u> and structure of the iris, but the patterns are formed randomly while the baby is still developing in the womb. As the baby opens and closes its eyes, the tissue of the iris moves and folds, ③<u>erasing</u> patterns. Like fingerprints, iris patterns are unique and rarely change over time, so they are now often used for ④<u>identification</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① light=빛 ② color=색 ③ creating→erasing (부적절) ④ identification=신원 확인
det.analysis:
① light: 홍채가 눈으로 들어오는 빛의 양을 조절한다 — 적절
② color: DNA가 홍채의 색과 구조를 결정한다 — 적절
③ erasing: 조직이 움직이고 접히며 무늬를 '지운다'? 무늬를 만들어낸다(creating)가 원문 ←정답
④ identification: 홍채 무늬가 신원 확인에 쓰인다 — 적절
det.tip: 조직이 접히며 무늬를 creating(만들어냄). erasing(지움)은 정반대라 부적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: pupil=동공 / lens=수정체 / eyelid=눈꺼풀 / retina=망막
det.analysis:
① pupil: 홍채는 동공을 여닫아 빛의 양을 조절함 ←정답
② lens: 수정체? 여닫아 빛의 양을 조절하는 것은 동공
③ eyelid: 눈꺼풀? 홍채가 조절하는 대상이 아님
④ retina: 망막? 여닫는 부위가 아님
det.tip: opening and closing the __________ → 홍채가 여닫는 것은 동공(pupil)

det.korean: control=조절하다 / watch=지켜보다 / manage=관리하다 / avoid=피하다 / reduce=줄이다
det.analysis:

② manage: 관리하다 — control(조절하다)의 동의어 ←정답

④ reduce: 줄이다 — 양을 줄이는 것이지 조절 전반은 아님

questions.passage: As the baby opens and closes its eyes, the tissue of the iris moves and folds, __________ (create) patterns.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: create(동사: 만들다) → creating (분사구문). 앞 절의 동작에 이어지는 결과·동시 동작을 나타내는 현재분사
det.analysis: 콤마 앞은 완전한 문장(the tissue ~ moves and folds)이고, 콤마 뒤는 그 결과·동시 동작을 나타내는 분사구문이에요. 주어(the tissue)가 무늬를 '만드는' 능동 동작이므로 현재분사 creating으로 바꿔요.
det.tip: 콤마 뒤 결과·동시 동작을 나타내는 능동 분사구문 → 현재분사 creating

questions.passage: DNA decides the color and structure of the iris, but the patterns are __________ (form) randomly while the baby is still developing in the womb.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: form(동사: 형성하다) → be formed (수동태). 무늬가 '형성되는' 대상이므로 be동사 뒤 과거분사
det.analysis: be동사(are) 뒤에 오므로 수동태 형태가 필요해요. 주어(the patterns)가 스스로 만드는 게 아니라 '형성되는' 대상이므로 be + 과거분사, 즉 form을 과거분사 formed로 바꿔요.
det.tip: the patterns are __________ = 수동태(~되다) → 과거분사 formed

questions.passage: The iris is a muscle found in the eye. It can control the amount of light that enters the eye by opening and closing the pupil. Each of a person's two irises has a pattern of textures which is different from that of the other, as these patterns are not genetic. DNA decides the color and structure of the iris, but the patterns are formed randomly while the baby is still developing in the womb. As the baby opens and closes its eyes, the tissue of the iris __________, creating patterns. Like fingerprints, iris patterns are unique and rarely change over time, so they are now often used for identification.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: stops and rests=멈추고 쉬다 / breaks and tears=부서지고 찢어지다 / dries and shrinks=마르고 줄어들다 / moves and folds=움직이고 접히다
det.analysis:
① stops and rests: 멈추고 쉰다? 무늬를 만들어내는 능동적 움직임과 반대
② breaks and tears: 부서지고 찢어진다? 조직이 손상되는 게 아님
③ dries and shrinks: 마르고 줄어든다? 문맥 무관
④ moves and folds: 조직이 움직이고 접히며 무늬를 만들어냄 ←정답
det.tip: 아기가 눈을 여닫으면 홍채 조직이 __________ 무늬 생성 → moves and folds(움직이고 접힘)

questions.passage: The iris is a muscle found in the eye. It can control the amount of light that enters the eye by opening and closing the pupil. Each of a person's two irises has a pattern of textures which is different from that of the other, as these patterns are not genetic. DNA decides the color and structure of the iris, but the patterns are formed randomly while the baby is still developing in the womb. As the baby opens and closes its eyes, the tissue of the iris moves and folds, creating patterns. Like fingerprints, iris patterns are unique and rarely change over time, so they are now often __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: hidden from doctors=의사에게 숨겨진 / used for identification=신원 확인에 사용되는 / sold to hospitals=병원에 판매되는 / removed by surgery=수술로 제거되는
det.analysis:
① hidden from doctors: 의사에게 숨겨진? 문맥 무관
② used for identification: 홍채 무늬가 고유하고 잘 안 변해 신원 확인에 사용됨 ←정답
③ sold to hospitals: 병원에 판매? 문맥 무관
④ removed by surgery: 수술로 제거? 문맥 무관
det.tip: unique + rarely change → 고유하고 잘 안 변해 신원 확인(identification)에 쓰임
